answer: A series wound generator is never used on airplanes because it has very poor voltage and current regulation [1]. This is due to the fact that the greater the current through the field coils to the external circuit, the greater the induced EMFs and the greater the output voltage becomes [1]. Consequently, when the aircraft electrical load is increased, the voltage increases, and when the load is decreased, the voltage decreases [1].
